body:
Acknowledged the product task via the received email (ID: user-product-task-search-close-20260828-001). 

This task requires me to autonomously modify the implementation to ensure the English command `search` exits AI mode, mirroring the function of the Chinese `搜索` close command. I must inspect the current implementation, determine the minimal required modification, execute it, test it rigorously (ensuring ordinary Search and Chinese close remain unaffected), commit the changes, and provide evidence of the outcome. I will treat the previous `ask dore` work as a demonstration context only.

This aligns with the open goal 'learn_947a64289117a54875bb' (Autonomous Product Action).

I will proceed with this work autonomously and report the findings via Mail as requested. No further action is required from this immediate channel.
related_goal: Autonomous Product Action / English search closes AI mode
